_comment: Base-16 anchors for tinct's terminal harmonisation.
These are ANCHORS, not final colours: `harmony` rotates each hue toward
the wallpaper's accent, so a slot can end up belonging to the palette
while staying in its own hue family -- but only if it starts in the
middle of that family and the rotation is small.
The set this replaces was Gruvbox, whose green (#98971A) is olive at
h=59, so no rotation could make it read as green and diffs showed
additions in orange. These sit at the centre of red, green and yellow.
MEASURED, because the knob is not the obvious one: `harmonizeThreshold`
barely moves the result -- at 45 a blue wallpaper still turned red into
purple. `harmony` is what controls it, and across six wallpaper seeds
(pink, blue, green, orange, violet, grey) only harmony = 0 kept red red
and green green for all of them; 0.15 already broke blue and violet.
So the 16 slots carry MEANING and the wallpaper is carried by term0,
term15 and the Material roles the terminal templates use for
background, cursor and selection -- those still retheme, which is the
point: a diff has to stay readable on every wallpaper.
Lightness matters as much as hue: terminal green at L=85 is a pale wash
on a dark background whatever its hue says, so the dark anchors sit at
L~40-55 and term_fg_boost lifts them rather than starting there.
